cards.title: Second Baby? You'll Forget Everything
cards.body: A second-time mum discovers she's forgotten crucial details about baby basics like feeding and teething. Her own mother's help stirs memories of a blissfully simple childhood.

cards.title: Should AI Help With Parenting?
cards.body: Tech companies offer eye-tracking tools and optimized nap predictions to help parents. But do families actually need this tech, or is it solving problems that don't exist?

cards.title: Empty Nest: When Your Child Leaves Home
cards.body: A parent faces unexpected emotional turmoil as her first son prepares for university. The reality of 'empty nesting' hits harder than she anticipated.

cards.title: Could Strep Infection Cause Child Anxiety?
cards.body: A strep infection can dramatically transform a calm child into an anxious one overnight. Most parents and doctors never check for this overlooked connection.

cards.title: Understanding Teen Vaping Addiction
cards.body: Vaping is a genuine addiction with serious grip on young people. Families, schools, and communities can support recovery and protect vulnerable teens.

cards.title: Helping Rural Domestic Violence Victims
cards.body: Domestic violence affects both urban and rural areas, though rural victims report less frequently. Targeted strategies can empower families in remote communities.

cards.title: UK Schools Tackle GCSE Resit Crisis
cards.body: Resits are up as schools struggle with a 'relentless' cycle that doesn't work. Pass rates for maths and English resits remain significantly lower.

cards.title: School Grieves Loss of Teen and Family
cards.body: Ellen Wilkinson School for Girls pays tribute to Sara El-Khawas, 14, and her family who died in a sea tragedy off Shoreham. The community is deeply saddened.
